newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius' Fincorp profit up 19 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius' Fincorp profit up 19 pct.

text.p: Investment firm Fincorp on Thursday reported a 19 percent rise in pre-tax profit to 42.7 million rupees ($2.1 million) for the year ended 30 June 1996.
Fincorp's financial accounts showed turnover increased by 29 percent to 46.6 million rupees during the same time period and after-tax profit went up by 32 percent to 41.1 million rupees.
Investments of the company as at 30 June 1996 totalled 367.7 million rupees down from 439.2 million rupees one year earlier.

But the company's net investment in finance leases activities through its wholly owned subsidiary Finlease, amounted to 109.7 million rupees as at 30 June 1996. Finlease began its operations in August 1995.
